role: exposed development, conditional resampling description; no new confirmatory claim
primary_metric: Q=mean_h(MSE_model_h/MSE_RW_h), equal horizon weights; lower is better
effect: 100*(Q_reference-Q_main), positive favors main; normalized RW percentage points, not RMSE percentage change

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap over common observed-record origins
bootstrap.random_stream: one numpy default_rng per market; block20 then40; common sampled indices for every model and horizon
bootstrap.replicate: sample ceil(n/block_length) starting origins uniformly, append modulo-n consecutive blocks, truncate to n
bootstrap.rw_denominator: recompute separately for each horizon within each draw
bootstrap.zero_rw_draw: record invalid count and exclude only that invalid draw; never replace denominator silently
bootstrap.secondary: same-EWT Ridge comparisons and RW comparisons report pointwise intervals only, outside the two declared families
bootstrap.adaptation_strategy: each family's primary online strategy chosen solely on validation; fixed within resampling; all five strategy point scores retained
bootstrap.scope: per-market conditional intervals; no joint across-market coverage, no new p-values, no claim to adjust for the broader already-exposed research search

analysis_source: Analysis implementation may be written after fits but must implement this frozen plan; source and numerical replay receipt will be published.
decision: Report measured main-model improvement and matched mechanism increment separately. No invented universal publication percentage threshold. Full-series effects retain their complete-sequence information label.
